name: Standing hip flexion
summary: Holding a wall, bring one straight leg forward from the hip without leaning back — the forward banded kick.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, one hand on a wall beside you, working leg nearest the phone. Keeping the knee straight and the trunk upright, bring the leg forward to about 35–45°, then lower it under control. With a band, loop it around the working ankle and anchor it behind you.
brief: Stand side-on with one hand on a wall. Keeping the knee straight and the trunk upright, bring the working leg forward, then lower it under control.
why: Side-on, the working ankle travels forward past the hip and how far it gets — as a share of the thigh — counts the rep. Leaning back to swing higher takes the shoulders behind the same hip, which is the same reading on the trunk, and a bent knee or a leg going the wrong way are both read directly.
calibrationPose: Stand tall, feet together, one hand on the wall beside you.

progress.overCue: Not so high — keep it controlled
progress.overTip: Past about 60° the pelvis tucks under and the lower back takes over from the hip flexors.

progression: Band around the ankle anchored behind; a heavier colour.
regression: Smaller swing; both hands on the wall.
contraindications: Pinching at the front of the hip, or low-back pain on the swing.

faults.label: Leaning back to swing higher
faults.cue: Stand tall — do not lean back
faults.tip: Leaning back makes the leg look higher without the hip flexors doing more, and loads the lower back.

faults.label: Bending the knee
faults.tip: A bent knee shortens the lever and the swing the camera sees; keep the leg long.

faults.label: Swinging the leg backward
faults.cue: Take the leg in front of you
faults.tip: This one goes forward only. Swinging backward is a different exercise and the band is pulling the wrong way.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; a swung leg is momentum, not the hip flexors.

faults.label: Tucking the pelvis under
faults.tip: At the top of the swing the pelvis tries to tuck under to gain height. Keep it level and accept less range.

guide.surface: Firm floor and a wall or chair within reach of one hand.
guide.stop: Pinching at the front of the hip, or low-back pain.
guide.cannotSee: The pelvis tucking under at the top, and how hard the band is pulling.

points.t: Straight knee throughout — a bent one is flagged.
Upright and still; the shoulders going behind the hip is leaning back, not flexing.
Ribs down and the pelvis level — the camera cannot see this one.
Stays put; it is what the coach measures the swing against.
Forward 2 s, pause, lower 2 s. No swinging.
